Done — the game is written to **`snake_ollama-mimo-v2.6-flash-rl-mxfp4_01.html`** (single file, ~23 KB, HTML + CSS + JS, no dependencies).

- **Keyboard controls** — Player 1: Arrow keys or WASD. Player 2: I/J/K/L (so human-vs-human works on one keyboard). No reversing into yourself.

- **Start menu** — title, mode buttons, control legend and instructions.
- **Game over screen** — winner headline (Player/CPU 1/2 Wins, or Draw), final scores, restart hint.
- **Restart by keypress** — **Enter**, **R**, or **Space** restarts the same mode; **M** returns to the menu (also usable mid-game).
